notes.title: Alpha Demo Update - More Chaos, More Fixes!
notes.content:
[p]Hey explorers,[/p][p]I’ve been hard at work shaping the alpha-demo based on your feedback, and I’m really excited to share a fresh update with you! This one adds more challenge, clears up navigation, and fixes some pesky bugs that were holding things back.[/p][h2]🔹 What’s New[/h2][list][*][p][b]Challenging Rooms[/b]: Expect more enemies and new [b]laser hazards[/b] for extra chaos.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Drops[/b]: Increased drop chances to keep things fairer when the action heats up.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🔹 Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Door Arrows[/b]: Now point in the exact direction of exits.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Tracker[/b]: Unvisited rooms are now marked with a [b]?[/b] for easier exploration.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🔹 Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Character Rotation Bug[/b]: No more random spins when switching weapons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Key Bindings[/b]: Your custom keyboard/gamepad setups now save correctly between runs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you all so much for playing, sharing feedback, and being part of this journey. Every comment and playthrough helps me make [b]O3: Hollow Descent[/b] a stronger and stranger experience.[/p][p]With surreal love,
[b]Simy[/b][/p]

notes.title: Update Now Live – New Content & Features
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]
Here in Italy, it’s already starting to feel like autumn, even though we’re still technically in summer. I hope you're all getting some well-deserved sun, rest, and good energy, whether you're already on vacation or still waiting for one. Wishing you a great end of summer wherever you are.[/p][p]Now onto the update: a new build for [i]03 - Hollow Descent[/i] is live on Steam, bringing new content, improved systems, and better customization options.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s included:[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Totem Reward System[/h2][p]After clearing nearly every combat room, a totem-like structure now spawns and drops random loot:[/p][list][*][p]Weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Synthralls[/p][/*][*][p]Passive upgrades[/p][/*][/list][p]This new system adds more consistency and depth to exploration and combat pacing.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Faster Dash Refill[/h2][p]Dash cooldown has been shortened to allow quicker evasive movement and support a more aggressive playstyle.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Settings Menu Overhaul[/h2][p]The entire settings interface has been restructured into a single, simplified page. New options include:[/p][list][*][p]Movement Type: Switch between World-Based or Screen-Based controls[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad Vibration: Toggle On/Off[/p][/*][*][p]Screen Shake: Toggle On/Off[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-Aim for Gamepad: Off, Low, Medium, High[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard Movement Rebinding: Fully remappable movement keys[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Map Tracker Tool + Session Stats[/h2][p]A new map system has been added to help you navigate and track your progress:[/p][list][*][p]Room-by-room tracking of explored areas[/p][/*][*][p]Points of interest are revealed upon entering rooms[/p][/*][*][p]A Session Stats panel displays key run information:[/p][list][*][p]Time played[/p][/*][*][p]Rooms cleared[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies killed[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons found[/p][/*][*][p]Chests opened[/p][/*][*][p]Secret rooms discovered[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for playing and supporting [i]03 - Hollow Descent[/i].
More updates and improvements are coming soon.[/p][p]Simy[/p]

notes.title: Alpha Demo Update: Bug Fixes & Improvements (July 2025)
notes.content:
[p]Quick Update[/p][p]Hi everyone! Here’s a small but important update to improve your experience:[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where clicking the close button on the teleport panel would unexpectedly shoot your weapon.[/p][p]- Weapons now automatically resume firing after reloading:  no need to release and press the fire button again.[/p][p]- All weapons now correctly track ammo even while holstered, preventing unwanted auto-reloads.[/p][p]- Increased the spawn rate for certain loot to make runs more rewarding.[/p][p]- Guaranteed chest key drops: you’ll now always receive at least one chest key during each session run.[/p][p]
That’s it for now. More updates and improvements are coming in the next days.[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone playing and sending feedback, it really helps shape the game.[/p][p][/p]
